objective: Sincronizador: diagnosticar el trabajo activo de re-sincronización Comercial por rango que lleva aproximadamente 30 minutos en ESTELAR para un solo día. Solo lectura; identificar estado, bloque, fase, último heartbeat/progreso y mensajes. No modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: latest_comercial_range_jobs
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 5 ResyncLogID, Estado, Mensaje, UnidadCodigo, RegistrosAfectados, SolicitadoPor, FechaEjecucion, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.status') AS payload_status, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_unit') AS current_unit, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_block') AS current_block, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_phase') AS current_phase, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.percent_complete') AS percent_complete, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.updated_at_utc') AS updated_at_utc, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.created_at_utc') AS created_at_utc, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.successful_steps') AS successful_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.failed_steps') AS failed_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.completed_steps') AS completed_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.total_steps') AS total_steps FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_ResyncLog WHERE TipoSync='comercial_range_batch' ORDER BY ResyncLogID DESC
